div.head: Hl 4
div.ab: Gif bana oþbyrste, twam manwyrþum hine man forgelde ⁊ hine gecænne mid godum æwdum, þæt he þane banan begeten ne mihte.
Gif bana oþbyrste, twam manwyrþum hine man forgelde ⁊ hine gecænne mid godum æwdum þæt he þane banan begeten ne mihte.
Gif bana oþbyrste, twam manwyrþum hine man forgelde ⁊ hine gecænne mid godum æwdum, þæt he þane banan begeten ne mihte.

Wenn jener Todtschläger entwischt, [so] entgelte man ihn [nämlich der Eigenthümer den Erschlagenen] durch zwei Knechtspreise und reinige sich mit guten Eideshelfern, dass man den Todtschläger nicht erlangen konnte.

If that killer escapes, [then] let him be paid for [namely, by the owner to the slain man’s side] with two slave-prices, and let him clear himself with good oath-helpers that he could not get hold of the killer.
If the homicide escapes, [his owner] shall pay for him with two wergelds and prove by good witnesses that he has not been able to lay hands on the homicide.
If the slayer escapes, he is to be paid for with the value of two men, and [the owner] is to clear himself with good oath-helpers, that he could not capture the slayer.
If the killer should escape, [the owner] should compensate him with two man-worths, and clear himself with good oath-helpers, that he was not able to seize the killer.

note.seg: Der Satz stimmt in der Formel mit Hl 2
The sentence agrees in its formula with Hl 2
Nicht etwa den entflohenen Knecht, wie Frühere verstehen; denn diesen entgilt éin Sklavenpreis laut o. 2; statt ‘man’ nächster Z. setze ‘er’
Not, say, the escaped slave, as earlier scholars understand it; for he is atoned for by a single slave’s price, as above 2; for ‘man’ in the next line read ‘er’
